scope: Standalone native Omni extension and pinned upstream source; no model weights.

checks.cpu_integrated_build: passed: omni-server, omni-generate, omni-decode, omni-quantize, audio-join, visual-reply and server-security targets
checks.cpu_audio_join: passed: 10 ms overlap, no inserted silence, unchanged within-phrase samples
checks.cpu_visual_reply: passed: UTF-8 splits, pointer binding, malformed/truncated suffixes
checks.http_authentication: passed: actual upstream HTTP middleware on ephemeral loopback; both voice and cancel reject absent/wrong key with 401 and accept the test key
checks.non_loopback_startup: passed: 0.0.0.0 without key refuses before model loading; unit cases include IPv4, IPv6, hostname and empty keys
checks.pcm_example_client: passed: synthetic HTTP/SSE fixture; byte-exact PCM, stale generation rejected, gap/EOF/error cancel and remove partial output
checks.standalone_build_source_guard: passed: incompatible library-source directory rejected by CMake
checks.cuda_module_build: passed against retained matching pinned upstream CUDA shared libraries with the precision patch; not a fresh CUDA rebuild of all upstream libraries
checks.small_budget_negative_probe: 1400 MiB admitted the recurrent-frame test but rejected decoder workspace explicitly; this is not a supported total VRAM minimum
checks.vendor_original_hashes: all 13 original source hashes verified; every distributed vendor source has MIT identification and per-file provenance

secret_scan.reviewed_false_positives: 43 SHA-256 manifest matches, 1 synthetic PNG, 1 placeholder curl key, 2 xxhash intrinsic names

limitations: No new long-form voice/listening benchmark in release preparation. Historical GPU evidence is in tools/loraai_omni_native/VALIDATION.json.
No GPU server end-to-end rerun or additional platform qualification in release preparation.
Secret scanning does not prove absence of all sensitive information. Source scope and added documentation were reviewed separately.
